# DQF Expiration Tracker

> Free DQF expiration tracker for owner-operators and small fleets (1–5 drivers). Estimated next due dates based on FMCSA Part 391. Driver labels and dates stay in the browser; no account or upload.

## Pages
- [DQF Expiration Tracker](https://dqfsuite.com/): free date calculator for medical certificates, MVR pulls, CDL expiration, annual reviews, road tests, and employment verification.
- [How to build your first DQF](https://dqfsuite.com/blog/how-to-build-your-first-dqf/): guide to the documents, dates, and common gaps. A guide, not a compliance determination.
- [Privacy policy](https://dqfsuite.com/privacy/): local storage, export, deletion, and what this build does not collect.
- [Terms of service](https://dqfsuite.com/terms/): service description, no legal advice, acceptable use, liability.
- [Pricing](https://dqfsuite.com/pricing/): free during validation; Pro plan is not yet available.
- [Refund policy](https://dqfsuite.com/refund/): how refunds are handled once paid plans launch.

## Facts
- Rules version: 2026-11-13.
- Price: free during validation. No payments are available in this build.
- Data storage: browser localStorage under `dqf_tracker_v1`; JSON export and import are available.
- Optional first-party analytics in three states: before you choose, one minimal identifier-free page-visit count per path; with consent, event names, bucketed counts, page path, device type, referrer host; if rejected, no analytics requests are sent. Never driver names, dates, or backup contents.
- Limits: up to 5 drivers per browser.

## Disclaimer
Estimated based on FMCSA Part 391. Not legal advice. Does not guarantee compliance or audit results.
